premises.text: Students stuck before homework or finals cannot get on-demand peer help or easily form study groups, widening the achievement gap
premises.evidence_span: It's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups if students cannot easily share knowledge or resources. And overall, if students who really need the extra help can't get it, and this increases the achievement gap

premises.text: Study Room connects classmates via school email into course pages for collaborative guides and free shared files including prior semesters
premises.evidence_span: Using a study room is as easy as signing up with your school email. And because we have all the course information, adding your classes is just a tap and a tap. Then you're immediately connected with everyone at your school, and most importantly, with your classmates

premises.text: Peer Mentor Program places platform-selected peer tutors on course pages for affordable on-demand one-on-one sessions
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow every single college student to offer online, on-demand tutoring sessions and make some money while helping others

value.text: Help college students master coursework with peer help when they need it
value.evidence_span: get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it

secondary_value.text: Peer mentors earn money for college
secondary_value.evidence_span: make some money while helping others
